_about: S6 qa-50: short questions with one exact answer. Asked one at a time, temperature 0, 48 tokens at most. Right when any 'accept' string is in the reply (case-insensitive, thousands commas removed). The score is compared across engines on the same model: a drop on one engine points at the engine, not the model.
system: Answer with the answer only: no working, no full sentence.
